title: Grade 2 Stage D Execution Ledger
caution: This ledger records passed named digital tests on the referenced source SHA. It is NOT academic approval, full authenticated per-lesson E2E, CI certification of the ledger commit, or release authorization.

local.proofBoundary: TRX contains one or more named passing test cases for each Grade 2 lesson ordinal; this does not establish a complete per-lesson authenticated runtime acceptance.

gitHubActions.warning: The authenticated acceptance workflow is B001/G1-scoped. It is not proof of all 146 Grade 2 lessons.

outstandingGates: G1 independent fail-closed gate: 96 previously approved V1 lessons have stale source/grading exact-candidate proof; must be genuinely revalidated, not re-stamped
Grade 2: lesson-by-lesson authenticated student/teacher integration E2E with isolated test database and persisted grading evidence not yet proved
Grade 2: teacher/source checks of original images, measurements, student authored work, classroom activities, source permissions and academic sufficiency required
Final required Actions matrix must be green for the release candidate commit and production approval must be recorded before merge/deployment
